title: Tax Graph Node
description: A single addressable point in the graph: a form line, box, worksheet field, normalized taxpayer fact, computed value, or reusable concept.

document_id.description: The document this node belongs to.

line.description: Printed line carried by an unresolved source stub.

label.description: Human-readable label, e.g. 'Net capital gain or loss'.

required.description: Whether this node must be present; 'conditional' is gated by a fact or decision.

status.description: Lifecycle status for a source-backed external stub.

stub_message.description: What must happen before an unresolved stub can be computed.

constant_value.description: Literal value for cited parameter nodes or other graph constants.

citation_refs.description: Ids of citation objects that authorize/explain this node.

table_id.description: Optional repeatable-table id when this node is a table member.

column.description: Optional table column id when this node is a row-template or total column.

role.description: Optional table role for repeatable-table member nodes.

gate.description: Orthogonal provenance axis: who stood at the promotion gate.
